title: Speak to Lucy

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Ugh. Can you step back a bit? Your aura is clashing with mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh. Can you step back a bit? Your aura is clashing with mine.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Oh yeah, you think we're friends, don't you? That's cute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yeah, you think we're friends, don't you? That's cute.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Nyx-Curzona? Yeah, we... I mean, no. I have literally no idea who you mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nyx-Curzona? Yeah, we... I mean, no. I have literally no idea who you mean.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Seriously? Your aura is giving me a headache, so if you wouldn't mind...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? Your aura is giving me a headache, so if you wouldn't mind...

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Well, maybe I've, like, HEARD of him, but it's not like we had the same nanny or anything. I'm not WEALTHY wealthy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, maybe I've, like, HEARD of him, but it's not like we had the same nanny or anything. I'm not WEALTHY wealthy!
Maybe.
Why should I tell you?
You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: As he should be. Surprised he hasn't jumped the LUZ and fled to Luna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As he should be. Surprised he hasn't jumped the LUZ and fled to Luna.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Alright, fine! I don't remember everything, Bo Bo had some slugjuice going around, but apparently Eldridge tried to… *mumble*

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, fine! I don't remember everything, Bo Bo had some slugjuice going around, but apparently Eldridge tried to… *mumble*

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Err, because he's a CURZONA. If his aunt found out he was trying to undermine the basic principles of supply chain competitiveness ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Err, because he's a CURZONA. If his aunt found out he was trying to undermine the basic principles of supply chain competitiveness ...

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Well... that's what Minty told me that PorridgeDog told her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... that's what Minty told me that PorridgeDog told her.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: You can't. She's off having an aura cleanse. But Ziggy was the one who told PorridgeDog. Talk to him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can't. She's off having an aura cleanse. But Ziggy was the one who told PorridgeDog. Talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: To start a library! A free one. Apparently he said it would stock all the fashion holos. As well as… textbooks. Bleurgh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To start a library! A free one. Apparently he said it would stock all the fashion holos. As well as… textbooks. Bleurgh.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: RIGHT?! I mean, if his aunt heard that he was trying to undermine the basic principles of supply chain competitiveness ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: RIGHT?! I mean, if his aunt heard that he was trying to undermine the basic principles of supply chain competitiveness ...

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Look, don't quote me on any of that, OK? Like I said, I was TOTALLY chem-trailed. You should talk to Zig, Ziggy, he'll know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, don't quote me on any of that, OK? Like I said, I was TOTALLY chem-trailed. You should talk to Zig, Ziggy, he'll know.
Ugh, shut UP!

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: ... she’d have him ex-communicated. Plus engaging in that sort of community collaboration is just, like, EXTREMELY gauche.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... she’d have him ex-communicated. Plus engaging in that sort of community collaboration is just, like, EXTREMELY gauche.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No way to treat a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No way to treat a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No way to treat a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No way to treat a friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whatever. Look, do you know Eldridge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. Look, do you know Eldridge?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Whatever. Look, do you know Eldridge?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Whatever. Look, do you know Eldridge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I don't anymore.
Do you know Eldridge?
You just said his name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were at a party with him recently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were at a party with him recently.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You were at a party with him recently.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You were at a party with him recently.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were at a party and Eldridge did something. What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were at a party and Eldridge did something. What?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You were at a party and Eldridge did something. What?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You were at a party and Eldridge did something. What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because he's worried about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because if you don't, I'll tell everyone you're actually a duchess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because if you don't, I'll tell everyone you're actually a duchess.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because if you don't, I'll tell everyone you're actually a duchess.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because if you don't, I'll tell everyone you're actually a duchess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So...
Try me.
And that's bad why...?
SWEET MERCY.
So that's definitely what happened?
Where can I find Minty?
Tried to what?
So gauche.
Thanks, Duchess.
Well, thanks I guess.
You remember nothing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just by chance: Have you seen him recently?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just by chance: Have you seen him recently?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just by chance: Have you seen him recently?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just by chance: Have you seen him recently?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Loud and clear, please, Duchess!
